← Back to campus

A campus built from observation.

283 photo galleries, street-level views, architecture sources and elevation references used to guide the recreation. Photographs remain at their original sources; they are visual references, not copied game textures. Modelled façades and many dimensions remain approximations.

QUAD COURTYARD 2019

Quadrangle · Sardaka courtyard tower photograph, 2019

March 2019 photograph by Sardaka visually inspected. Tower stands over the central covered passage: stepped ochre brick, square Roman-hour sundial, dark louvres, upper open frame with steel ties. Academic wings show open colonnades, recessed gallery, cream classroom panels, projecting balconies and high glazing. The 27 m tower estimate and internal dimensions are reconstructed; no photograph is rehosted as a scene asset.

ELECTRICAL LANDSCAPE PLAN

G17 and Rex Vowels · public landscape strategy and plan

Printed pp. 18–19 (PDF pp. 9–10) rendered and inspected. Plan locates insitu concrete bleachers, integrated planting and timber seating between Rex Vowels and College Road, paved shared zone, southern forecourt, low planted edge and glazed balustrade. The completed architect project describes an outdoor amphitheatre. Six model seating tiers, eighteen stair treads, detailed footprint and local ground shaping remain estimated. Raw DEM and source footprints remain intact.
